next: Qualify and run minimal spatial logit correction at selected LR. Replicate control and candidate with a second independent seed if relative KL improves by at least 1%, without more than 15% warm decode latency regression. All exploratory outcomes retained.
primary: Full validation KL at update 1024; retain every scheduled evaluation.

selection: Choose the lowest endpoint KL among completed 3e-4, 6e-4 and 1e-3 controls. No convergence claim.
